records.DESCRIPTION: ABS Outstanding : As mentioned in Finding 156.1, temporary repair was carried out by applying epoxy putty to the external surface of the distance piece at damaged area. The SUS Ring (size: 330 mm (O.D.) x 80 mm (H) x 5 mm (t)) was fitted, and epoxy putty was also applied around the side shell and SUS ring.

ABS Outstanding : As reported by the Owners, the EGCS distance piece/overboard pipe of the Generator Engine had been found wasted and was repaired temporarily by means of a cement box, in order to eliminate the water ingress. Vessel was attended at this time in order for the effectiveness of the temporary repairs to be verified. 
In particular the following were verified to the satisfaction of the attending surveyor:

- 
Cement box and the surrounding area were inspected and their condition was deemed satisfactory.

- 
Extensive thickness measurements (TMs) were taken on the accessible sections of the pipe both upstream and downstream of the overboard pipe. This gauging was performed to determine the extent of corrosion and to ascertain, as far as reasonably practicable, the absence of further deterioration or potential failure points.

- 
The bilge alarm system, bilge pumping system, and emergency bilge suction operation were tested.  The crew provided a satisfactory demonstration of their operation in an emergency scenario.
